title: 0 Of 7 Brain Networks Matched The Left-Right Myth
hook: Scientists tested 7 brain networks. The myth matched none.
closing: Your brain works as one team, so personality cannot belong to one side.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language sits about 96 percent in the left side for right-handers, but personality does not split by side.
Scientists tested 7 brain networks, and none matched the left-brain, right-brain myth.
About 200 million nerve fibers link the brain's halves, constantly sharing signals across both sides.
